conditions: Applies to the authors’ specific quotation-literal description and higher-order combinators.
limitations: The account treats a quotation as a first-class object. Other parse-time constructs and current release behavior are outside this claim.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: The Factor authors’ 2010 account describes square brackets around tokens as forming a quotation literal that is pushed on the stack and delays evaluation of those tokens. Combinators can take the quotation object as a parameter.
